newsitem.title: USA: Bay State cuts jobs, to save $4.8 mln a yr.
newsitem.headline: Bay State cuts jobs, to save $4.8 mln a yr.

text.p: Bay State Gas Co said Friday it will eliminate about 70 clerical and professional jobs in its fiscal year ending September 1997, reducing its staff in these positions by 12.5 percent.
The company said it will achieve the cuts through an early retirement program, enhanced severance and extended benefits programs.

The estimated $7.5 million in costs associated with the job cuts will be deferred for accounting purposes, the company said. The company said it expects to see operating savings of $4.8 million a year from the cuts.
The company said the deferral of the $7.5 million costs requires regulatory approval.

The company is scheduled to go before regulators in April 1997 to obtain approval, said company spokeswoman Carol Churchill. "Given that, the earliest we believe that we would be able to start recognizing the deferral would be in 1998," Churchill said.
